claims.claim: arA'ayta is a call to look/attend, not a literal question about seeing; the listener is asked to see what the man IS, not how he looks
yura'un is mutual seeing (mufa'ala): the show-er watches the watchers; mirror (mir'at) as the instrument; ruwa' = fair appearance
two gazes: the God-commanded gaze that reaches depth vs the gaze these men seek that stays on the surface
ayah-by-ayah movement: 2 = pointing finger/habitual push; 3 = unseen absence; 4-5 = prayer; 6 = whose eyes; 7 = hidden small withholding
Qur'anic parallels: ara'ayta in Alaq, 'God sees' (96:14, 26:218), 4:142, 4:38, 76:9, 92:19-20
yukezzibu = deny/call false; kadhib is verbal and practical; kezzabe cloth and 'kadhaba' stalled-motion idioms (camel milk, charge, wild animal) as image of surface vs interior
'din' as the judgment/reckoning that looks beneath paint (dayyantu = leave to his niyya)
fa- makes pushing the consequence/visible proof of denial
'an salatihim = distance from prayer, not within it; contrasted with 23:2 fi salatihim khashi'un; they pray while outside prayer
ruwa' and the stop-and-look run (wild animal) pattern; prayer stops when the audience leaves
Qur'anic scenes of surface vs depth
yatim from ghafla/ibta'; sahw from another root defined by ghafla; the men are the ghafla; Suha star (small, hidden, overlooked)
Qur'anic parallels for sahun and yatim
yadu'u = harsh, rude push (dafa' shadid / dafa' fi jafwa); same root: shepherd's cry, 'da' da'' (get up), da'da'a (fill measure); di'a' = small children
yahuddu = urge to good; la yahuddu = does not even say one word urging feeding; hadid = lowest ground
yemne'une = standing between a man and what he wants; mana'a root also protective kin circle (men'a)
Qur'anic parallels for pushing, urging, withholding
a household beneath the surah: di'a' (children), seken (household, provisions), sehve (porch/shelf), ma'an (house); ma'un as shelf goods: axe, pot, bucket
ma'un = small, light, easy thing (ma'n), usually returned; borrowing practice between neighbours
da'da'a = shake a measure so it fills; the hand that could fill measure pushes the orphan away
Qur'anic parallels for filled vessels / refused vessels
ma'un = flowing water (ma'in, mu'nan); ma'un is also named for water; ground watered; food reaching to water
Qur'anic ma'in and 'arA'aytum' tie; haven with water; 'whoever does not taste it' for river water
musallin shares root with sala (fire); the image is heard beside the meaning, not instead of it; veyl as cry of doom (tagged source:memory in base)
Qur'anic fire/denial/withholding parallels (69:34 is word-for-word with 107:3)
din = recompense/debt/obedience; 'kezebe aleykum' = obligation; fa'il saves the denial of a ledger; last object (ma'un) = ta'a/zakat so first and last objects meet in obedience
Qur'anic ledger parallels (Infitar, Ma'arij, Fussilat, Isra, Dhariyat)
salat has two sides: legal form and du'a; 9:103 salat/zakat/sakan loop; the men cut the loop in the middle
Qur'anic salat+mal pairings

Meetings: Suha sentence joins sight and oversight; Alaq as joint scene; Tur joins pushing and fire; Haqqa 69:31/34; Muddaththir 74:42-46 retells the whole surah; ma'un joins house, water, debt; the surah ends where it began in obedience
